newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian postal train derailed by mudslide.
newsitem.headline: Italian postal train derailed by mudslide.

text.p: A postal train was derailed by a mudslide in northern Italy on Wednesday, slightly injuring two drivers, after a heavy rainstorm hit the region, police said.

The incident happened in the early hours of the morning as the train neared a station in the Alpine lake region north of Milan. Traffic on part of the line was suspended but officials hoped to resume normal services during the afternoon. The drivers were not seriously hurt.
